purpose: Design previews; no application UI changes

variants.title: 1 — Paper
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity Nanohub repository web app design exploration, preview only. Input image 1 is a CONTENT AND INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE, not a style to copy. Create ONE polished flat desktop screenshot per output, landscape 1536 by 1024 composition. No laptop frame, no perspective, no presentation montage, no explanatory labels outside the app.
Primary request: Make this Git hosting app slightly distinct from GitHub's visual design language while keeping repository workflows instantly recognizable. Keep Nanohub's own identity; no GitHub logo. Preserve the same core information and controls across all variants: owner "nanohub-test", repository "git-ui-fixture", small "Private" label, navigation "Code", "Issues", "Pull requests", "Actions", "Agents" with count "2", and "Settings". Repository controls "main", "Branches", "History", "Go to file", and a primary "Clone" action. Commit row: "Local fixture", "Local hosting UI fixture", short hash "fb9c17b". File table columns "Name" and "Object", exactly two rows: folder ".github" with hash "dee77aa"; file "README.md" with hash "b44dbf2". README heading "Local repository fixture" and body "Synthetic data for testing owner/repo addresses and the Actions queue." A quiet right-side About area may say "Git repository hosted on Nanohub." Use a small simple Nanohub three-dot square brand mark.
Require crisp legible text, practical developer-tool spacing, sensible 14px UI type at normal desktop scale, clear hierarchy, compact controls, high contrast and precise alignment. Keep realistic dense product UI; no marketing hero, decorative art, invented features, invented metrics, stars or forks, fake charts, gradients, glass effects, heavy shadows, huge pills or excessive rounded cards. Do not just recolor GitHub: give this a coherent own visual language.
Direction 1 — PAPER: quiet, warm, precise. Warm off-white canvas, clean white file and README surfaces, charcoal type, warm gray fine rules, very restrained muted terracotta accents. Use neutral owner text and bold dark repository name instead of blue GitHub links. A compact top application bar with "nanohub" wordmark, then owner/repo identity and a subtle horizontal navigation strip. Selected "Code" is a small pale warm-gray inset tab with dark text, no coral underline. The Clone button is solid charcoal, not GitHub green. Corners about 4–6 px, almost no shadows. System sans-serif UI and monospace hashes; warm but fully professional, refined reading-room character. Keep content left and center with a modest About column to the right. Airier than a terminal but not oversized. This should be an immediately shippable alternative to the reference.
